mapper.insert: insert into daily_report (dept_id, delivery_date, total_amount, create_time, update_time) values (#{deptId}, #{deliveryDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT d.name AS deptName, SUM(dr.total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM daily_report dr JOIN dept d ON dr.dept_id = d.id WHERE dr.delivery_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

select d.name as deptName, p.name as productName, di.delivery_weight as deliveryWeight, di.remaining_weight as remainingWeight from daily_report dr join daily_report_item di on dr.id = di.report_id join dept d on dr.dept_id = d.id join product p on di.product_id = p.id where dr.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} order by d.id, p.id
